# Zoetis Petcare

> Zoetis Petcare provides veterinary-approved pet health products, wellness resources, and a rewards program to help pet owners care for their dogs and cats.

Zoetis Petcare is a 65-year-old pet health company offering prescription and over-the-counter medications, a mobile app called The Pack for health tracking and rewards, and educational resources. The company partners with American Humane and Adopt a Pet to support shelter animals and pet adoption.

## Key Topics

## Products & Treatments

- [Our Products](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/products): Catalog of Zoetis Petcare products including Librela, Apoquel, Bonqat, and Fetch Points rewards.
- [Simparica Trio for Pet Owners](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/products/simparica-trio): Product page for Simparica Trio monthly chew for heartworm and parasite prevention.

## Mobile App & Rewards

- [Get The Pack App](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/app): The Pack app for pet health tracking, rewards, and vet guidance.
- [Get The Pack App Download](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/app-download): Download page for The Pack app on iOS and Android platforms.
- [Rewards Program FAQ](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/rewards/faq): FAQ about Zoetis Petcare Rewards program, points, and membership.
- [Sign In](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/sign-in): Account login for Zoetis Petcare Rewards program members.

## Pet Health Resources & Guides

- [Helpful Resources Just for You](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/resources): Vet-approved guides, checklists, and health resources for pet parents.
- [Supporting Your Pet Adoption Journey From A-Z](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/guides/pet-adoption): Expert guide for newly adopted pets covering health, parasite protection, and adjustment.
- [A Guide to Your Pet's Mental Wellness](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/guides/pet-mental-health): 7-day guide to pet mental health, behavior, and wellness tips.
- [Blog](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/blog): Vet-approved pet care guidance and wellness articles for pet owners.

## Company & Partnerships

- [We Take Care of Pets, Like Pets Take Care of You™](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/about): Company information about Zoetis Petcare's 65-year history and mission.
- [Our Friends on the Front Lines](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/american-humane): Partnership with American Humane for emergency pet rescue and veterinary services.
- [Partnering for the Future of Shelter Pet Care](https://www.zoetispetcare.com/adopt-a-pet): Partnership with Adopt a Pet to improve shelter pet healthcare and education.
